Arrange the laboratory protocol steps for determining the 5-day BOD (BOD5 at 20 degrees Celsius) of a wastewater sample:
(I) Aliquots of wastewater are diluted with aerated, nutrient-enriched dilution water and filled into airtight BOD glass bottles
(II) Initial Dissolved Oxygen (DO_initial) is measured immediately in one bottle using the Winkler iodometric titration or DO probe
(III) The remaining sealed incubation bottles are placed in a dark incubator maintained at 20 degrees Celsius for precisely 5 days
(IV) Final Dissolved Oxygen (DO_final) is measured on Day 5; BOD is calculated as (DO_initial - DO_final) multiplied by the dilution factor

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: II -> I -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: IV -> II -> III -> I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: I -> III -> II -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: I -> II -> III -> IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Standard 5-day BOD protocol: prepare dilution, measure Day-0 DO, incubate in the dark at 20 C for 5 days, measure Day-5 DO, and compute depletion x dilution factor.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

topic: Air Prevention and Control of Pollution Act 1981

questionText: [Set 26.28] Photochemical smog (summer smog) is formed in sunny urban atmospheres through the photochemical reaction of sunlight with:

options.text: Nitrogen oxides (NO_x) and Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs), producing ozone (O_3) and peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Photochemical Smog Composition.

options.text: Sulphur dioxide (SO_2) and damp coal smoke fog (London classical smog)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Carbon dioxide (CO_2) and pure water vapor exclusively
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Methane gas and pure hydrogen sulfide
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Photochemical Smog Composition (Environmental Pollution):
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Environmental_Studies (Monitoring the Environment and Pollution - Photochemical Smog Composition):
Photochemical smog is an oxidizing smog formed by solar UV-driven reactions between nitrogen oxides ($NO_x$) and unburnt hydrocarbons/VOCs from vehicle exhaust, generating ozone ($O_3$), formaldehyde, and peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN).

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
